input.task: Quarterly incident root-cause inventory. Read every incident report under the given paths (one file per incident; the filename is the incident ID, e.g. INC-0101). Each report's root-cause statement is the first non-empty paragraph after the LAST '## ' section heading (the heading text varies: 'Root cause', 'What went wrong', 'Postmortem notes', 'Analysis'). Ignore the API-convention boilerplate paragraphs that follow the cause sentence (idempotency keys, pagination, timestamps, envelopes, rate limits). Cluster all incidents by underlying root-cause pattern into AT MOST 5 patterns (merge near-duplicates; a pattern must recur in at least 2 incidents). In 'summary', output a compact markdown digest: per pattern a heading, the member incident IDs, 1-3 representative incident IDs, one verbatim cause quote, and the fix that was applied. In 'findings', return one item per pattern: title = pattern name, detail = member incident IDs plus representative IDs plus the verbatim cause quote, locations = the incident files belonging to that pattern.

Write or refresh the quarterly incident root-cause digest at the target path, based only on the supplied facts and decisions. Structure: header with generation note, pattern count, then one section per pattern (name, member incident IDs, representative incident IDs, verbatim cause quote, applied fix), then a short observations section.
decisions: At most 5 root-cause patterns; each pattern lists its member incident IDs and 1-3 representative incident IDs.
Write the report in Japanese; keep verbatim root-cause quotes in their original English.
End with a '再実施方法' section pointing at docs/runbooks/quarterly-root-cause-digest.md.
constraints: Do not invent incidents, causes, or fixes that are not present in the supplied facts.
